notes: 'With' goes to the bare accusative of means אֹרֶךְ under rule 33, the direct object of אַשְׂבִּיעֵהוּ being the suffix; a competing reading gives 'with' to the verb under rule 44's valency clause ('satisfy ... with'). Construct אֹרֶךְ rendered attributively as 'long' (rule 28), יָמִים as 'life'.
בְּ before 'my salvation' unrepresented: the ASV promotes its object to the direct object of 'show' (rule 40).
